evals.prompt: Ho appena ricevuto il manuale di installazione di una pompa centrifuga industriale in PDF. Puoi farmi un riassunto tecnico in italiano in Word? Lo allego adesso.
evals.expected_output: A structured .docx report in Italian with [INTRODUCTION], [DISCUSSED TOPICS] (covering installation steps, technical specs, safety warnings, maintenance), and [SUMMARY] sections. File named summary_*_IT.docx.

evals.prompt: Can you summarize the technical content at this URL for me? https://www.anyurl.com/product-datasheet-example — I need it in English as a PDF.
evals.expected_output: Claude fetches the URL, analyzes content, asks only for format confirmation (since language is given), then produces a structured PDF summary in English named summary_*_EN.pdf.

evals.prompt: Allego tre documenti tecnici (schede tecniche di componenti elettronici). Voglio un unico report che li sintetizzi tutti e tre, in italiano, formato Markdown.
evals.expected_output: Claude aggregates all three files into one corpus, analyzes combined content, and produces a single .md file in Italian covering all topics across the three documents.

evals.prompt: Here are two URLs from the manufacturer's site: [url1] and [url2]. Generate a technical comparison summary in English as a Word document.
evals.expected_output: Claude fetches both URLs, aggregates content, and generates a .docx summary in English that covers topics from both sources, properly structured.

evals.prompt: Questo è un articolo scientifico sulla corrosione dell'acciaio inossidabile in ambienti saline. Riassumilo in francese come PDF.
evals.expected_output: A structured PDF report in French with introduction, discussed topics (methodology, findings, material properties, conclusions), and summary. Acronyms expanded in French.
